statements.text: A bill to provide a national framework to sustain American leadership in artificial intelligence, to require an actionable Federal plan aligned to that policy, and to establish a temporary moratorium preempting certain State laws that restrict artificial intelligence models and systems engaged in interstate commerce [...]
statements.context: Introduction of public bills and resolutions on the House floor during a routine legislative session.

statements.text: Nor do we want them to train AI models to enable weapons of mass destruction, automated cyber attacks, or systems that evade human oversight.
statements.context: House floor remarks during debate on the Remote Access Security Act, which extends export controls to cloud-based remote access of controlled U.S. technology.
